extDescription.message: A modern, friendly popup for configuring the browser's native proxy settings.

statusUnknownTitle.message: This proxy configuration can't be edited here

statusUnknownBody.message: It may be managed by another program or use an unsupported proxy mode. Change it in the browser settings first, then retry.

statusPolicyTitle.message: Proxy settings are managed by policy

statusPolicyBody.message: Your organization's browser policy controls the proxy. Proxima can't change it.

statusOtherExtensionTitle.message: Another extension is controlling the proxy

statusOtherExtensionBody.message: Applying here may be overridden. Proxima will verify the result after applying.

statusUnsupportedTitle.message: Proxy settings aren't supported on this platform

statusUnsupportedBody.message: Firefox for Android doesn't support changing the proxy from an extension. Use Proxima on desktop.

statusPrivateGateBody.message: Firefox only lets an extension change the global proxy setting when it's allowed in private windows — even if you don't use private windows.

statusPrivateGateStep1.message: Open about:addons in a new tab.

statusPrivateGateStep3.message: Turn on “Run in Private Windows” and allow it.

statusPrivateGateStep4.message: Come back here and click Re-check.

statusPrivateGateHelp.message: How to allow extensions in private windows

statusPrivateGateStill.message: Still not allowed. Follow the steps above, then re-check.

statusApplyWarning.message: Applied, but the browser reports another controller. Check the setting or retry.

statusApplyUnverified.message: Applied, but the new state couldn't be read back.

statusApplyRefused.message: The browser refused the change. Another extension or policy may be in control.

manualProxyDnsHint.message: Keeps DNS lookups off your local network when using SOCKS.

manualShareHttps.message: Also use this proxy for HTTPS

manualHttpsSeparateHint.message: Fill this in to use a different proxy for HTTPS. It disables the shared HTTPS option.

manualShareDisabledHint.message: Clear the separate HTTPS proxy to share the HTTP one.

manualBypassHint.message: Hosts, domains or CIDR ranges that connect directly. localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 always bypass the proxy.

manualAutoLogin.message: Don't prompt for authentication when the password is saved

manualAutoLoginHint.message: Firefox will use saved proxy credentials silently.

manualAtLeastOne.message: Enter an HTTP or SOCKS proxy server.

manualShareNeedsHttp.message: Add an HTTP proxy before sharing it with HTTPS.

manualPacHint.message: Use an http(s) URL. Extensions can't force a PAC reload; re-apply after editing the file.

manualPacInvalid.message: Enter a valid http(s) PAC URL.

manualPacCredentials.message: PAC URLs can't include a username or password.

manualHostInvalid.message: Enter a valid hostname or IP address.

errorReadBody.message: Firefox may be using the system WPAD option, which the extension API can't read. Choose another proxy mode in Firefox settings, then retry.

errorReadBodyGeneric.message: Proxima couldn't read the browser's current proxy setting. Retry; if it keeps failing, check for another extension or policy that manages the proxy.

errorPrivate.message: Firefox requires private-window permission before Proxima can change the proxy.

errorPolicy.message: Proxy settings are managed by policy and can't be changed here.

errorUnsupported.message: Proxy settings aren't supported on this platform.

errorNotApplied.message: The browser didn't accept the change.
